How many animals will Melissa groom each day of the week? Melissa works as a pet groomer. This week, Melissa has 8 dogs that need to be bathed, 5 cats that need their nails clipped, 3 birds that need their wings trimmed, and 12 horses that need to be brushed. Melissa splits the grooming jobs evenly over the days of the week.
